command.description: Open the ESP32 pane: serial ports, online status and chip info
pane.title: ESP32
fail.busy: Port busy (close the serial monitor or other serial tool and retry)
fail.no_response: The board did not answer (check the cable, or hold BOOT and press RST for download mode)
fail.incomplete: Chip found, but its MAC or flash size could not be read (the flash may be faulty)
driver.howto: Device Manager → right-click the device → Update driver → Search automatically; or Windows Update → Optional updates
python.missing: Python not found. Install Python 3, or set ESP_PYTHON to a python.exe
python.deps: pyserial / esptool missing: {detail} -m pip install --user pyserial esptool
empty: No ESP serial device found. Check the cable (some only charge) and the USB port.
polling.paneOnly: Not scanning while the pane is closed
mon.state.waiting: waiting for the port to come back…
mon.busyHint: Another program holds the port (a monitor, a flasher…). Close it, then press Retry
wifi.reason.200: beacon timeout, weak signal or AP off
flash.confirm: Flash {file} at 0x0 on {port}? This replaces the program on the board.
flash.done: Flashed {file} in {time}; the board was restarted and the new firmware is starting
flash.error.not_esp_image: Not an ESP image (a .bin must start with 0xE9); pick the merged .bin
flash.error.too_big: The file is larger than the board's flash
flash.error.already_flashing: This board is already being flashed
flash.hint: To flash: type /esp32 flash <full path of a merged .bin> {port} in the chat box
flash.error.no_board: No board to flash; add the port, e.g. /esp32 flash C:/fw/a.merged.bin COM4
flash.error.wrong_chip: This image was not built for an ESP32-S3
flash.error.not_merged: Not a merged image (no partition table at 0x8000). Pick the .merged.bin, not the app or bootloader .bin
flash.error.interrupted: Flashing was interrupted (Velloc closed or a timeout); the board may hold an incomplete program, flash again
pane.heading: ESP32 assistant
health.probing: Identifying the chip… (the board restarts once)
health.crashed: The program crashed — see the red crash lines below (try the Errors/warnings filter)
health.busy: Another program holds the port — close the serial monitor or flasher, then press Retry
health.waiting: Waiting for the board to come back… (unplugged, or restarting)
health.unprobed: Connected, chip not identified yet — press Identify chip
health.idle: Identified as {chip} — press Start monitor to see what it prints
wifi.row.unknown: 📶 Wi-Fi: nothing about Wi-Fi in the log yet
rssi.nonstandard: not a standard dBm value; probably the program's own print
reset.title: Last restart: {text}
reset.crash: CPU software reset (the program called esp_restart, or it restarted after a crash)
reset.watchdog: watchdog timeout: the program was stuck too long
reset.brownout: brown-out: the supply voltage dropped; check the USB cable and power
log.title: Serial log · {errors} errors · {warnings} warnings
flash.title: Flash firmware
flash.overwrite: This replaces the program on the board. Don't unplug it while flashing.
flash.dontUnplug: Don't unplug the board or close Velloc
flash.advice.busy: Close the program that holds the port (serial monitor, Arduino IDE), then flash again
flash.advice.no_response: Hold BOOT, press RST, release BOOT, then flash again
flash.advice.interrupted: Run /esp32 flash again to write the whole image
flash.advice.error: Check the serial log, or try another USB cable
empty.title: No ESP board found yet. Try this:
empty.step1: 1. Use a USB cable that carries data (some only charge)
empty.step2: 2. Use the board's USB port marked UART/COM, or another USB port on the computer
empty.step3: 3. Open Device Manager and look for a device with a yellow warning sign (missing driver)
footer.autoScan: Scanning serial ports every 2 s; a board shows up as soon as it is plugged in
driver.title: A driver is needed
python.title: Python needs setting up
health.download: The board is in download mode — release BOOT, then press RST
health.noFirmware: No runnable program on the board (blank flash or broken image) — flash a firmware
health.silent: Monitoring, but the board prints nothing yet — press Restart board, or check the program uses 115200 baud
log.noWifi: Nothing about Wi-Fi in the log
log.cleared: Cleared; new output will appear here
footer.noScan: Serial ports are scanned once Python is set up
ai.title: 🤖 AI diagnosis
ai.running: 🤖 NVIDIA Nemotron is reading the log…
ai.credit: Analysed by {model} on Nebius Token Factory in {seconds} s
ai.sent: Sent: chip info, run summary, last {lines} log lines
ai.error.no_key: No Nebius API key yet: run setx NEBIUS_API_KEY "your-key" in PowerShell, then restart Velloc
ai.error.bad_key: The Nebius API key was rejected; copy it again from the Token Factory console
ai.error.network: Cannot reach Nebius Token Factory; check the network
ai.error.timeout: The model took too long; try again
ai.error.server: Nebius Token Factory returned an error; try again
